opening.argument: The presentation offers cryptocurrency packages from 500 to 5,000 euros, with larger packages bringing more bonus coins. It also ties compensation to recruitment: referring buyers can earn commissions, and matching bonuses and greater payment are linked to a growing network. The financial pitch extends beyond commissions. It presents conditional future coin-price scenarios, gives an example of doubled earnings tied to 5,500 euros in volume during the first 30 days, and urges viewers to partner with the team. Although some figures are framed as predictions or subject to qualification, the combined pitch connects paid entry and network growth with prospective financial returns. Those features establish a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scheme, not simply a discussion of cryptocurrency.
